com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Correct the quantities, prices or other supported values on one selected saved invoice line. Financial changes can reset approval. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: For the saved line we selected on our fictional practice invoice, preview changing quantity to 2, unit price to 12.50, tax amount to 0 and total to 25.00. Show any approval impact and wait for my confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_edit_invoice_line_item, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare changes to one previously read invoice line. Requires confirmation; financial changes can reset approval.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token
